training_objectives.FL_localization: cross entropy on the 288 training events
training_objectives.FP_forewarning: binary cross entropy with logits; pos_weight is the D01-D04 eligible training negative/positive ratio only
training_objectives.FD_AE: observed numeric sequence masked MSE; current-step observed numeric squared residual mean at scoring
training_objectives.FD_TranAD_adapted_v2: bounded logistic two-stage self-conditioned reconstruction with explicit opposing decoder-2 gradients; not claimed as an exact-paper reproduction
training_objectives.FD_KAN_AD: author KANAD shared-univariate first-difference current-anchor forecast; Adam lr=0.003 and StepLR(5,0.75)

checkpoint_selection.FD_detection: minimum D05 current-normal reconstruction or forecast loss

event_evaluation.alert_time: first positive valid grid point of each segment
event_evaluation.matching_order: process alerts by run_id, alert onset UTC, segment id; among unused candidate events choose event start UTC then event_id
event_evaluation.normal_exposure: sum 5 seconds for each eligible prediction-valid y=0 grid point; missing/ineligible/unscored points contribute zero and break segments
event_evaluation.threshold_objective: among thresholds with actual false-alerts/hour <= budget maximize main-event hits, then minimize false-alert count, then choose the higher threshold
event_evaluation.threshold_candidate_set: positive infinity plus exact finite D05 score values
event_evaluation.threshold_no_exact_budget_policy: report target, actual false alerts, actual false-alerts/hour, exposure hours and feasibility; never invent budget attainment

fp_onset_claim_boundary: prediction is relative to faults.jsonl start record; physical first-effect time and command-to-log latency are not certified
